problemFound.legacyState: Each of 60 supports was represented by a tilted rectangular bracket plus a solid cylinder. The cylinder axis did not establish a physically usable left/right pole bore and the mounting load path lacked a back plate, anchors and pivot.
problemFound.visualRisk: At frontal/oblique 4K framing the support could read as primitive-placeholder geometry, while a solid receiver would fail construction causality and could trigger the critical visible-primitive/hero-geometry defects.
problemFound.materialQaIssueCaughtDuringRun: The first refinement draft incorrectly treated the legacy scalar _Metallic field as authoritative. Existing detail materials use a canonical metallic/smoothness R/A map, and the danchi builder may rewrite ignored fallback scalars. The final validator delegates to QualityBlockDetailMaterialMicrostructureUpgrade and only requires finite normalized scalar fallbacks.
